summary: BCB Bancorp, Inc. announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 11,000,000 shares of its common stock at an implied price of approximately $7.75 per share, generating total gross proceeds of $85,250,000 before underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated offering expenses. The offering, filed via Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) and Item 9.01, is expected to close on September 18, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. The offering is structured as a cash capital raise, with the Company as the issuer of new shares. No board recommendation, advisor, or break fee is named in the excerpt. The deal increases the share count, creating potential dilution overhang; watch for the final pricing terms, use of proceeds, and any market reaction or regulatory considerations for the bank holding company.
